title: Abstract system-environment.md for Cross-Platform Support
details: Removed macOS hardcoded paths (/opt/homebrew, /bin/zsh) and replaced with token-efficient OS-agnostic dynamic detection directives.

title: Refactor inject-aliases Hook
details: Rewrote the inject-aliases.sh Bash script into inject-aliases.py so that the PreInvocation hook functions natively on Windows environments without WSL requirements.

title: Define explicit lifecycle properties for all .dev-ecosystem files
details: Injected @lifecycle persistent and @cleanup manual frontmatter/metadata into all 30 files within the .dev-ecosystem package to structurally prevent accidental deletion by ephemeral purge routines.

title: Codify Global vs Local execution scope
details: Formalized the Global vs Local installation matrix within the engine architecture by restructuring the .dev-ecosystem folder into global-assets and local-assets, structurally preventing strict local components from leaking into the global config.

title: Define Global vs Local Pointer Resolution for Third-Party AIs
details: Expanded the installer pointer resolution logic to dynamically write AI-specific configuration files (e.g. .cursorrules, CLAUDE.md, .github/copilot-instructions.md) into either the OS home directory or the local project directory based on the installation scope.

title: Shift ecosystem installer to Global-First Paradigm
details: Refactored the ecosystem into a global plugin. Renamed AGENTS.md to ECOSYSTEM_SETUP.md. Adjusted jldn-scaffold to act as the global anchor that conditionally pulls local-assets into new projects based on user opt-in.

title: Generate Ecosystem Documentation
details: Create comprehensive documentation detailing the new Global-First Paradigm and how to utilize jldn-scaffold.

title: Refine Hook Explanations
details: Document how the inject-aliases.py hook works for cross-platform (macOS/Windows) support.

title: Automated Validation
details: Set up a GitHub Action or local script to automatically validate the integrity of the .dev-ecosystem configuration files.

title: Linting & Formatting
details: Ensure the Python hooks and JSON configurations are properly linted.

title: Dummy Project Scaffolding
details: Created a dedicated dummy project (jldn-dummy-test) to test the 7-Color Auditing Suite safely.

title: audit-rainbow Stress Test
details: Executed the full audit-rainbow on the dummy project to verify that the newly formalized audit suite skills are functioning perfectly.

title: jldn-scaffold: Enforce Past Tense in Backlog Setup
details: The jldn-scaffold script generates the initial GEN-TODO-01 task with imperative tense ('Scaffold project structure') instead of the required past tense ('Scaffolded project structure').

title: jldn-scaffold: Enforce ISO-8601 Offset Timestamps
details: The jldn-scaffold script generates timestamps with the 'Z' suffix (e.g. 2026-08-21T12:00:00Z) instead of explicit timezone offsets (e.g. +00:00) violating the strict formatting rule.

title: jldn-scaffold: Bootstrap Baseline CI/CD Pipeline
details: The jldn-scaffold script generates an empty .github/workflows/ directory. It should bootstrap a baseline validation pipeline to ensure structural integrity out-of-the-box.

title: jldn-scaffold: Prevent Invalid Dependabot Config
details: The jldn-scaffold script generates dependabot.yml with an empty 'updates:' block, which is invalid syntax. It should be omitted or commented out if there are no package ecosystems.

title: jldn-scaffold: Data Loss / Secret Leak Prevention in .gitignore
details: The jldn-scaffold script generates a .gitignore that only excludes node_modules/ and .DS_Store. It must automatically ignore .env and .secrets/ to prevent accidental credential leakage (Blue Team DLP vulnerability).
